newsitem.title: USA: Wis. man charged with filming females in shower.
newsitem.headline: Wis. man charged with filming females in shower.

text.p: An apartment building manager has been charged with video taping female college students with a camera disguised as a smoke detector in a shower, officials said on Tuesday.

The Walworth County District Attorney's office said the 38-year-old man was preliminarily charged by police with "videotaping nudity" and was ordered to appear in court on Feb. 4. No charges had yet been lodged by prosecutors.
He was arrested on Saturday after a 20-year-old woman told police she was suspicious of a smoke detector in a shower.

"Investigation indicated that the manager did install the camera and may have installed another camera in a tanning booth room," Whitewater police said in a statement. "Police also confiscated computer equipment, computer discs and video tapes, which appeared to contain explicit sexual material."
The off-campus apartment building housed students from the University of Wisconsin's campus in this southern Wisconsin town.
